beats.summary: Michael confronts the bar manager about embarrassing his friends and asserts his own management style.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Hey, you embarrassed my friends in front of me and I'm gonna need you to go back over to the table and apologize.
Michael: Well, it just so happens that I am a manager too. And the way I manage people is that I touch their hearts and souls with humor, with love and maybe a dash of razzle-dazzle.

beats.summary: Michael humorously claims to be writing a management book called 'Somehow I Manage' which he has only written in his head.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I've written all of it… in my head.
Michael: If you're really interested, it's called 'Somehow I Manage' and there's going to be a picture of me on the cover, shrugging, with my sleeves rolled up.

beats.summary: Andy and Erin attempt to confuse others by pretending to flirt and interact with strangers during the happy hour.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Just sit down next to a beautiful woman and start talking to myself to confuse other people.
Erin: I was flirting with a man.

beats.summary: Angela serves Dwight with a summons for breach of contract related to their agreement to conceive and raise a child together.

evidence.snippet: Angela: You are hereby served with a summons to appear in Lackawanna county court.
Angela: Dwight recently entered into a contract with me, establishing intent to conceive and raise a child with me.

beats.summary: Darryl introduces Hide, a Japanese heart surgeon who fled to America after a mistake, and now has a new life thanks to Darryl.

evidence.snippet: Hide: In Japan, heart surgeon. Number one. Steady hand.

beats.summary: Michael reflects on the night, crediting his success partly to his alter ego 'Date Mike'.
